Method of Attack: Allows attackers with local access to gain root privileges by injecting and overwriting data in read-only files, including SUID processes that run as root
Impacted Systems: Android devices with affected Linux kernels
QNAP NAS devices running kernel version 5.10.60
QTS 5.0.x on all QNAP x86-based NAS and certain QNAP ARM-based NAS
QuTS hero h5.0.x on all QNAP x86-based NAS and certain QNAP ARM-based NAS
